## Chapters & Reference Topics
- [Overview, 4 Editions & Zero-Dependency C++20 Architecture](https://raggiesoftstudio.com/help-studio/web-manual): Meet HelpStudio.exe, rshbuild.exe, RaggieSoftHelp.exe, and the 4 editions (Community == Architect parity).
- [Importing Legacy .CHM, .HHP, WinHelp .HLP & .CNT Files](https://raggiesoftstudio.com/help-studio/web-manual/importing-chm-and-hlp): Decompile raw ITSF/LZX .chm and 3F 5F 03 00 .hlp + .cnt archives and scrub Word MsoNormal HTML.
- [Sub-5ms Named Pipe F1 Routing & Drop-In C++ / C# / VB6 SDKs](https://raggiesoftstudio.com/help-studio/web-manual/f1-context-routing-sdk): Wire WM_HELP, HtmlHelpCompatW, .NET WinForms/WPF, and Classic Visual Basic 6 forms to instant F1 help.
- [WCAG 2.2 AA Validation, Static Web Portals & Auto-VPAT 2.5](https://raggiesoftstudio.com/help-studio/web-manual/wcag-web-and-vpat): Enforce contrast, alt text, and heading hierarchy at compile time and export HTML5 VPAT 2.5 reports.
